new.procedure:
def apply(inputs, premises):
    total = int(inputs["ticket_price"])
    lengths = inputs["bag_lengths"]
    widths = inputs["bag_widths"]
    heights = inputs["bag_heights"]
    weights = inputs["bag_weights"]
    carry_limits = sorted(inputs["carry_on_dimension_limits"])
    base_fees = inputs["checked_base_fees"]
    standard_size = inputs["standard_checked_linear_size"]
    standard_weight = inputs["standard_checked_weight"]
    weight_uppers = inputs["overweight_upper_bounds"]
    weight_fees = inputs["overweight_fees"]
    size_uppers = inputs["oversize_upper_bounds"]
    size_fees = inputs["oversize_fees"]
    carry_used = False
    checked_index = 0
    for i in range(len(weights)):
        dims = sorted([lengths[i], widths[i], heights[i]])
        fits_carry = dims[0] <= carry_limits[0] and dims[1] <= carry_limits[1] and dims[2] <= carry_limits[2]
        if fits_carry and not carry_used:
            carry_used = True
        else:
            base_index = min(checked_index, len(base_fees) - 1)
            base_fee = base_fees[base_index]
            weight_fee = 0
            if weights[i] > standard_weight:
                for j in range(len(weight_uppers)):
                    if weights[i] <= weight_uppers[j] and weight_fee == 0:
                        weight_fee = weight_fees[j]
            linear_size = lengths[i] + widths[i] + heights[i]
            size_fee = 0
            if linear_size > standard_size:
                for j in range(len(size_uppers)):
                    if linear_size <= size_uppers[j] and size_fee == 0:
                        size_fee = size_fees[j]
            total = total + base_fee + max(weight_fee, size_fee)
            checked_index = checked_index + 1
    return {"answer": int(total)}

new.procedure:
def apply(inputs, premises):
    assets = inputs["asset_descriptions"]
    values = inputs["asset_values"]
    kinds = inputs["asset_kinds"]
    allowed = inputs["available_regimes"]
    citations = inputs["rule_citations"]
    caps = inputs["rule_caps"]
    multipliers = inputs["rule_multipliers"]
    rule_kinds = inputs["rule_asset_kinds"]
    rule_regimes = inputs["rule_regimes"]
    plans = []
    for i in range(len(assets)):
        claims = []
        for j in range(len(citations)):
            regime_allowed = rule_regimes[j] in allowed
            kind_matches = rule_kinds[j] == "any" or rule_kinds[j] == kinds[i]
            if regime_allowed and kind_matches:
                effective_cap = caps[j] * multipliers[j]
                claim_value = values[i]
                if caps[j] >= 0:
                    claim_value = min(values[i], effective_cap)
                claims = claims + [{"citation": citations[j], "claim_value": claim_value}]
        plans = plans + [{"asset": assets[i], "claims": claims}]
    return {"plans": plans}

def apply(inputs, premises):
    ticket_price = inputs["ticket_price"]
    lengths = inputs["bag_lengths"]
    widths = inputs["bag_widths"]
    heights = inputs["bag_heights"]
    weights = inputs["bag_weights"]
    carryon_caps = inputs["carryon_dimension_caps"]
    carryon_allowance = inputs["carryon_bag_allowance"]
    position_fees = inputs["checked_position_fees"]
    weight_mins = inputs["overweight_min_exclusive"]
    weight_maxs = inputs["overweight_max_inclusive"]
    weight_fees = inputs["overweight_fees"]
    size_mins = inputs["oversize_min_exclusive"]
    size_maxs = inputs["oversize_max_inclusive"]
    size_fees = inputs["oversize_fees"]
    bag_count = min(len(lengths), len(widths), len(heights), len(weights))
    carryons_used = 0
    checked_index = 0
    total = int(ticket_price)
    for i in range(bag_count):
        qualifies_as_carryon = False
        if carryons_used < carryon_allowance and len(carryon_caps) >= 3:
            qualifies_as_carryon = lengths[i] <= carryon_caps[0] and widths[i] <= carryon_caps[1] and heights[i] <= carryon_caps[2]
        if qualifies_as_carryon:
            carryons_used = carryons_used + 1
        else:
            base_fee = 0
            if len(position_fees) > 0:
                if checked_index < len(position_fees):
                    base_fee = position_fees[checked_index]
                else:
                    base_fee = position_fees[len(position_fees) - 1]
            overweight_fee = 0
            weight_band_count = min(len(weight_mins), len(weight_maxs), len(weight_fees))
            for j in range(weight_band_count):
                if weights[i] > weight_mins[j] and weights[i] <= weight_maxs[j]:
                    overweight_fee = max(overweight_fee, weight_fees[j])
            linear_size = lengths[i] + widths[i] + heights[i]
            oversize_fee = 0
            size_band_count = min(len(size_mins), len(size_maxs), len(size_fees))
            for j in range(size_band_count):
                if linear_size > size_mins[j] and linear_size <= size_maxs[j]:
                    oversize_fee = max(oversize_fee, size_fees[j])
            total = total + int(base_fee) + int(max(overweight_fee, oversize_fee))
            checked_index = checked_index + 1
    return {"answer": int(total)}

def apply(inputs, premises):
    ticket_price = inputs["ticket_price"]
    lengths = inputs["bag_lengths"]
    widths = inputs["bag_widths"]
    heights = inputs["bag_heights"]
    weights = inputs["bag_weights"]
    carryon_caps = inputs["carryon_dimension_caps"]
    carryon_allowance = inputs["carryon_bag_allowance"]
    position_fees = inputs["checked_position_fees"]
    weight_mins = inputs["overweight_min_exclusive"]
    weight_maxs = inputs["overweight_max_inclusive"]
    weight_fees = inputs["overweight_fees"]
    size_mins = inputs["oversize_min_exclusive"]
    size_maxs = inputs["oversize_max_inclusive"]
    size_fees = inputs["oversize_fees"]
    bag_count = min(len(lengths), len(widths), len(heights), len(weights))
    carryons_used = 0
    checked_index = 0
    total = int(ticket_price)
    for i in range(bag_count):
        qualifies_as_carryon = False
        if carryons_used < carryon_allowance and len(carryon_caps) >= 3:
            qualifies_as_carryon = lengths[i] <= carryon_caps[0] and widths[i] <= carryon_caps[1] and heights[i] <= carryon_caps[2]
        if qualifies_as_carryon:
            carryons_used = carryons_used + 1
        else:
            base_fee = 0
            if len(position_fees) > 0:
                if checked_index < len(position_fees):
                    base_fee = position_fees[checked_index]
                else:
                    base_fee = position_fees[len(position_fees) - 1]
            overweight_fee = 0
            weight_band_count = min(len(weight_mins), len(weight_maxs), len(weight_fees))
            for j in range(weight_band_count):

            linear_size = lengths[i] + widths[i] + heights[i]
            oversize_fee = 0

            for j in range(size_band_count):

            checked_index = checked_index + 1

    widths = inputs["bag_widths"]
    heights = inputs["bag_heights"]
    surcharges = inputs["surcharges"]

        cabin_item = False
        if fits_personal and not personal_used:
            personal_used = True
            cabin_item = True
        elif fits_carry_on and not carry_on_used:
            carry_on_used = True
            cabin_item = True
        if not cabin_item:

def apply(inputs, premises):

    widths = inputs["bag_widths"]
    heights = inputs["bag_heights"]
    weights = inputs["bag_weights"]
    carry_limits = premises["carryon_max_dimensions"]
    carry_index = -1
    for i in range(len(lengths)):
        if carry_index == -1 and float(lengths[i]) <= float(carry_limits[0]) and float(widths[i]) <= float(carry_limits[1]) and float(heights[i]) <= float(carry_limits[2]):
            carry_index = i
    base_fees = premises["base_checked_fees"]
    standard_weight = float(premises["standard_weight"])
    weight_bounds = premises["weight_upper_bounds"]
    weight_fees = premises["weight_fees"]
    standard_size = float(premises["standard_size"])
    size_bounds = premises["size_upper_bounds"]
    size_fees = premises["size_fees"]
    checked_ordinal = 0
    total_fees = 0
    for i in range(len(lengths)):
        if i != carry_index:
            fee_position = min(checked_ordinal, len(base_fees) - 1)
            base_fee = float(base_fees[fee_position])
            weight = float(weights[i])
            weight_fee = 0
            lower_weight = standard_weight
            for j in range(len(weight_bounds)):
                upper_weight = float(weight_bounds[j])
                if weight > lower_weight and weight <= upper_weight:
                    weight_fee = float(weight_fees[j])
                lower_weight = upper_weight
            total_size = float(lengths[i]) + float(widths[i]) + float(heights[i])
            size_fee = 0
            lower_size = standard_size
            for j in range(len(size_bounds)):
                upper_size = float(size_bounds[j])
                if total_size > lower_size and total_size <= upper_size:
                    size_fee = float(size_fees[j])
                lower_size = upper_size
            total_fees = total_fees + base_fee + max(weight_fee, size_fee)
            checked_ordinal = checked_ordinal + 1
    return {"answer": int(float(inputs["ticket_price"]) + total_fees)}
